clue.text: Henry and I excel, despite disadvantage

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance
taken as written
taken as written
to cap something is to outdo or excel it

explanation.surface: Someone shines in spite of a handicap, with Henry alongside.
explanation.definitionFit: A handicap is a hindrance or drawback that puts someone at a disadvantage.

clue.text: Male staff employed by old ruler

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a male
a rod is a staff or stick

explanation.surface: An ancient king takes on a man to join his household staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Herod was the king of Judea at the time of the Nativity, an ancient monarch.

clue.text: Proprietary medicament which too few buy

definitions.meaning: a branded medicine sold commercially is literally a drug for sale in the shops
the idiom for goods nobody wants, a glut that will not sell

explanation.surface: A patent medicine that the public will not purchase.
explanation.walkthrough: The usual idiom is 'a drug on the market'; this grid prints IN, which reads literally for the first sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally a pharmaceutical on sale; idiomatically something unwanted, in surplus with no demand.

clue.text: Diploma follows study in musical harmony

parts.note: to con is an old verb meaning to study or learn by heart
a cert, short for certificate, is a diploma

explanation.surface: A student earns a certificate after studying music theory.
explanation.walkthrough: CON, to study, is an archaic verb kept alive by crosswords; 'follows' sets the diploma after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in concert means in agreement, and concert originally meant accord among voices.

clue.text: Parliamentary madhouse for exiled dissidents

parts.note: parliamentary matters are political ones
an asylum is an old word for a mental hospital or madhouse

explanation.surface: A jibe that Parliament is a lunatic asylum, then a turn to refugees.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a descriptive phrase: this is the protection granted to dissidents exiled from home.
explanation.definitionFit: Protection a state grants to refugees fleeing persecution in their homeland is exactly what dissidents in exile seek.

clue.text: Composer takes girl to America

parts.note: a lass is a girl
US is short for the United States of America

explanation.surface: A musician carries his girlfriend off to the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Orlande de Lassus was a Renaissance Flemish musician who wrote masses and motets.

clue.text: The Spanish porter has to hang on

parts.note: la is a Spanish word for the (feminine)
porter and stout are both dark beers

explanation.surface: A Spanish hotel porter must keep waiting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'porter' looks like a hotel worker but is the dark beer; stout is a strong porter.
explanation.definitionFit: To last out is to endure or survive to the end, to hold on.

clue.text: To dine without fish means reorganisation

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the word for dining goes around the fish

parts.note: to sup is to eat supper, to dine
hake is a sea fish

explanation.surface: Dining with no fish on the menu signals a big change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' reads as lacking but here has its older meaning of outside, so the dining word wraps the fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A shake-up is a thorough reorganisation of a staff or system.

clue.text: Preserve spring lamb, maybe

definitions.meaning: a candied or crystallised fruit kept in sugar
tender young lamb is an example of meat that tastes sweet

explanation.surface: Advice to preserve young lamb in the spring.
explanation.definitionFit: A confection of sugared fruit; split in two, a description of tender, delicate flesh.

clue.text: Come back to soak large tea container

parts.note: to ret flax is to soak it to soften the fibres
an urn is a large vessel for making tea

explanation.surface: Instructions to come back and steep the leaves in a big teapot.
explanation.walkthrough: RET, soaking flax or hemp to loosen its fibres, is a crossword regular.
explanation.definitionFit: To return is to go back to a place or arrive again.

clue.text: Was demeaned by a ruined complexion

definitions.meaning: taken literally, a countenance that has gone missing or been spoilt

explanation.surface: Someone humiliated by a spoilt skin.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means suffered humiliation; read literally it is a visage that has been destroyed.

clue.text: It's industrious to dig inlet out

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are put out of their order, rearranged

explanation.surface: Digging out a creek is hard-working.
explanation.definitionFit: A diligent worker is hard-working and careful, the same as industrious.

clue.text: Protest at article

definitions.meaning: to raise an objection, to complain

explanation.surface: A complaint about a newspaper piece.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means oppose or complain; as a noun it means a thing or item.

clue.text: Delighted at interference from Brussels?

parts.note: the European Community, EC, is based in Brussels
static is crackling interference on a radio

explanation.surface: Someone thrilled at meddling from the EU bureaucracy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interference' suggests political meddling but is radio crackle.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecstatic means overjoyed, thrilled to bits.

clue.text: No hard cash is earned without effort

definitions.text: No hard cash is earned without effort

parts.note: something not hard is easy
money and cash are synonyms

explanation.surface: A complaint that no real money comes without labour.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines the answer too: money gained without hard work.
explanation.definitionFit: Easy money is income gained with little exertion.

clue.text: Let Pip mix the drink

indicators.note: to mix is to jumble together, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Allow Pip to make up the cocktail.
explanation.definitionFit: A tipple is an alcoholic beverage, a person's favourite tot.

clue.text: Rider delivers mail to one British rugby player

parts.note: to post a letter is to deliver it by mail
I is the Roman numeral for one
a Lion is a member of the British and Irish Lions rugby team

explanation.surface: A rider takes letters to a rugby player.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lions are the combined British and Irish rugby union touring team.
explanation.definitionFit: A postilion rode the leading horse of a team drawing a coach.

clue.text: Upheld by Yugoslav of magnificent nature

indicators.note: by here means held by, so the Yugoslav word is wrapped around the other piece

parts.note: a Serb was a citizen of the former Yugoslavia
the word splits as UP plus held, the held reinforcing that the two letters sit inside

explanation.surface: A Yugoslav is praised for his splendid character.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Upheld by' as 'UP held by': the setter runs the container phrase into one word, a looser device than usual.
explanation.definitionFit: Superb means excellent and splendid, magnificent in quality.

clue.text: Buccaneers traipse about

indicators.note: about signals moving the letters around into a new order

explanation.surface: Pirates trudging around the place.
explanation.definitionFit: Buccaneers were sea robbers of the Caribbean, the same as sea raiders.

clue.text: Sarcastic Pole gets the bird

parts.note: bitter remarks are sarcastic and cutting
N is the North Pole

explanation.surface: A caustic Polish man acquires a feathered friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' suggests a Polish person but is the North Pole, N.
explanation.definitionFit: The bittern is a wading heron known for its booming call.

clue.text: Guess it was taken with a telescopic lens

definitions.meaning: a wild attempt with little chance of success

definitions.text: it was taken with a telescopic lens
definitions.meaning: a photograph shot from far away with a zoom lens

explanation.surface: A guess about a photo taken through a zoom lens.
explanation.definitionFit: An outside chance or venture; also a photograph taken from a great distance.

clue.text: Radio links needed by deep-sea fishermen

definitions.meaning: a system of connected broadcasting stations
trawlermen must mend and handle mesh, literally labour with nets

explanation.surface: Trawler crews need radio links to stay in contact.
explanation.definitionFit: A chain of linked stations; split up, it describes labour with mesh, which trawlermen do.

clue.text: See 2
Noted arrangements for displaying jewels

definitions.meaning: musical versions of a text, set to notes
mounts in which gems are fixed on rings

explanation.surface: Arrangements noted for showing off gems.
explanation.definitionFit: Composers write musical versions of poems; jewellers fix stones into metal mounts.

clue.text: Flog shares in recession

indicators.note: receding means going backwards, so the word for shares is read in reverse

parts.note: parts are portions or shares

explanation.surface: Selling off stocks during an economic downturn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flog' suggests selling but means beat; 'in recession' turns PARTS around.
explanation.definitionFit: To strap someone is to beat them with a leather belt.

clue.text: A hard case causes heads torment

parts.note: nut is slang for the head
hell is torment or anguish

explanation.surface: A tough character gives the bosses grief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A hard case' suggests a tough person but is the woody shell of a nut.
explanation.definitionFit: The woody casing round a kernel is the tough container meant here.

clue.text: Man makes appeal to energetic royal

parts.note: O is an exclamation of appeal or entreaty, as in 'O Lord'
live means lively, full of energy
R stands for royal, as in RN for Royal Navy

explanation.surface: A man pleads with a lively member of the royal family.
explanation.definitionFit: Oliver is a boy's first name, so it names a man.

clue.text: Sycophants succeeded in Arabian republic

indicators.note: in places one item inside the other

parts.note: Yemen is a republic on the Arabian peninsula
S is the abbreviation for succeeded in genealogies

explanation.surface: Flatterers have done well in a Middle Eastern state.
explanation.definitionFit: Yes-men are flatterers who agree with everything the boss says.

clue.text: Preparing for a reconciliation

definitions.meaning: putting together or getting something ready, as a bed or a prescription
settling a quarrel and becoming friends again

explanation.surface: Getting ready to patch things up.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is assembling or getting ready; the other is restoring friendship after a quarrel.
